parameters.title: Parameters
parameters.intro: Default parameters come from the instrument version. Adjust them if needed before the assessment is locked.
parameters.layerWeightsHint: The three weights must add up to 1.00.

parameters.decimalHint: Use a comma or a full stop as the decimal separator, for example 0.35.

formulas.interviewTotal: sum of the two rows above
formulas.recommended: larger of Slovin and corrected Cochran

invitation.subject: Invitation to the occupational safety and health culture survey of {organization}
invitation.intro: {organization} and Nusa Safety are conducting a survey to measure occupational safety and health (OSH) culture. Your opinion matters for improving safety at work.

reminder.intro: We have not yet received your answers to the occupational safety and health (OSH) culture survey. The new link below replaces the previous one.

continue.subject: Continue the occupational safety and health culture survey of {organization}
continue.intro: You have opened the occupational safety and health (OSH) culture survey but have not submitted your answers. Continue from the same link on the same device you used before. Your answers so far are saved on that device.

email.anonymity: Your answers cannot be linked to your identity. Results are only presented in combined form for groups of at least five people.

email.linkIntro: Open the following link to start:

window.title: Survey window
window.intro: Times are in WIB (UTC+7). Survey links and QR codes only work between the opening and closing times.

import.title: Import respondent list
import.intro: Upload an Excel (.xlsx) or CSV file with the columns Name, Employee number, Email, Phone, Unit, Stratum, and Contractor. Required columns: Name, Unit, and Stratum. Unit names and stratum codes must match those registered in this assessment.
import.tooManyRows: The file has more than {max} rows. Split it into several files.
import.ready: All rows are valid. Review the summary, then save.
import.fixAndRetry: Nothing is saved until every row is valid. Fix the file, then check again.

rowErrors.ALREADY_REGISTERED: A respondent with this value is already registered.

lines.line1: 1. Enter one respondent per row in the "Daftar responden" sheet. Do not change the header row.
lines.line2: 2. Required columns: Name (Nama), Unit, and Stratum (Strata). Other columns may be left empty.
lines.line3: 3. Choose Unit and Stratum from the lists in the "Options" sheet so they match the assessment exactly.
lines.line4: 4. Email is used for invitations and reminders. Respondents without email can receive a link from the coordinator or use the unit QR code.
lines.line5: 5. Enter phone numbers as text, for example 081234567890. Numbers are stored in +62 format.
lines.line6: 6. Contractor (Penyedia jasa) is Ya (yes) or Tidak (no). If empty, the stratum setting applies.
lines.line7: 7. Employee numbers and emails must not repeat in the file or match respondents already registered.
lines.line8: 8. Contact data is stored encrypted and is never linked to survey answers.

invite.title: Email invitations
invite.intro: Sends invitations to respondents with email who do not have a token yet. Links are created when the email is sent. Automatic reminders are sent at 08.00 WIB at most three times, at least three days apart, only while the survey window is open.
invite.none: No respondents with email are waiting for a token.

links.title: Links for coordinators to share
links.intro: Issues links for respondents who do not have a token yet, for example to share by text message. Automatic reminders are not sent for these links.
links.once: Links are shown only this once. Download the CSV file now; the links cannot be shown again after you leave this page.
links.warning: Store this file securely. Each link is personal and gives access to one survey.

errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The capture is larger than 25 MB. Record a shorter one.
errors.FILE_SIZE_MISMATCH: The capture was not sent completely. Try again.
errors.UPLOAD_MISSING: The capture was not sent completely. Try again.
errors.UPLOAD_EXPIRED: The sending time ran out. Try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many uploads. Wait one minute.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not authorised for this unit.
errors.NETWORK: The connection was lost. Check the signal and send again.
errors.EXPIRED: Your session has ended. Sign in again.

manifest.name: NSCAS Digital Observation
manifest.description: Photo and video capture for occupational safety and health (K3) culture observations at project sites.

validation.intro: Online validation through interviews, focus group discussions, and virtual site visits. The application does not provide video conferencing; use a Zoom, Google Meet, or Microsoft Teams link.

proposal.title: Proposed sessions
proposal.intro: Calculated from the sample calculator: individual interviews for management and supervisory strata, focus group discussions for supervisory and field strata with at most {max} participants per session, and virtual visits for the projects to visit.
proposal.missing: Save the sample calculator result first on the Sample calculator page.
proposal.unallocated: Quota not allocated because no matching stratum exists: {interviews} interviews and {participants} focus group participants.
proposal.created: {count} sessions created. Set the schedule and meeting link for each session.
proposal.exists: Sessions already exist. The proposal cannot be created again, to avoid duplicates.

fields.label: Session name
fields.meetingUrlHint: HTTPS link from Zoom, Google Meet, or Microsoft Teams.

guides.title: Question guides
guides.intro: One example validation question per characteristic for each job layer. The lead assessor can edit them for this assessment.
guides.readOnly: Only the lead assessor can edit the guides.

session.noGuide: This session has no guide yet.
session.formIntro: Rate 1.0 to 5.0 (in steps of 0.5) only the characteristics discussed in the session. Leave the others empty. Your ratings are not visible to other assessors on this form.
session.recordingConsent: Interviewees agreed to the session being recorded
session.notesHint: Do not write interviewee names in the notes. The interviewee list is stored separately.
session.ratingsClosed: Validation ratings can only be entered during data collection and scoring.
session.participantsIntro: Stored separately from notes and ratings, for the report appendix. Statements in the notes are not linked to names.

scoring.intro: Evidence rating per characteristic by each assessor. Other assessors' ratings are shown after you save your own, so that ratings do not influence each other.

list.title: Characteristics
list.name: Characteristic
list.coverage: {count} of {total} characteristics have been rated by at least two assessors.

workspace.statementsIntro: Use the five statements as a reference. A rating between two levels is expressed in steps of 0.5.
workspace.noEvidence: No evidence has been mapped to this characteristic yet.
workspace.observationsIntro: Observation items are not mapped to characteristics. Mark the recordings you rely on.
workspace.rationaleHint: Required, at least {min} characters. Name the evidence or observations behind the rating.
workspace.closed: Evidence ratings can only be entered during data collection and scoring.
workspace.hidden: {count} other assessors have rated. Their ratings are shown after you save yours.
workspace.noOthers: No other assessor has rated yet.

scl.title: Safety Culture Ladder equivalent track
scl.link: Fill in the Safety Culture Ladder equivalent track
scl.intro: Percentage of criteria met per aspect per step, 0 to 100, with a rationale. The result is an internal diagnosis, not a Safety Culture Ladder certificate.
scl.scale: Criterion scoring reference: fully met 100, largely met 80, partly met 40, not met 0.
scl.complete: All aspects and steps are filled in.
scl.incomplete: Incomplete. The equivalent track is included in the engine run once all aspects and steps 2 to 5 are filled in.
scl.readOnly: Only the lead assessor fills in the equivalent track, during data collection and scoring.

run.title: Scoring engine run
run.intro: The engine computes stratum population-weighted perception, evidence, and validation from the latest data, and saves the result as a run. It can only be run while the assessment is in scoring.
run.done: The engine has run. Organisation index {index}.
run.stale: Input data changed after the latest run. Run the engine again before the panel meeting.
run.notAllowed: The engine can be run once the assessment is in scoring.

panel.intro: Triangulation matrix per characteristic from the engine run. The lead assessor adjusts final values where needed, with a required rationale, and then confirms the result.
panel.draftRibbon: Draft, not yet confirmed by the panel meeting
panel.finalRibbon: Confirmed by the panel meeting on {time} by {name}.
panel.noRun: No engine run yet. Run the engine on the Assessor scoring page.

matrix.title: Triangulation matrix
matrix.sources: Survey {answers} answers and {dontKnow} do not know; evidence {assessors} assessors; validation {sessions} sessions

lists.reconcileIntro: The spread between the highest and lowest assessor rating exceeds the threshold. Discuss the evidence each assessor used.
lists.divergenceIntro: The gap between perception and evidence reached the threshold. When evidence is lower, the final value uses the evidence value.

summary.title: Result
summary.scl: Safety Culture Ladder equivalent track: indicative level {level}
summary.sclMissing: The equivalent track was not included because it was incomplete at the time of the run.

adjust.title: Value adjustment
adjust.intro: The engine value remains stored and is shown in the report alongside the panel value.

finalize.title: Confirm the result
finalize.intro: Once confirmed, the result and adjustments cannot be changed. Move the assessment to action planning from the Overview page.
finalize.confirm: I understand the result cannot be changed once confirmed.
finalize.notAllowed: Adjustments and confirmation are only possible while the assessment is in panel review.

dashboard.intro: Summary of assessment results. Values derived from survey answers with fewer than 5 respondents are hidden.
dashboard.draftRibbon: Draft, not yet confirmed by the panel meeting
dashboard.finalNote: Result confirmed by the panel meeting on {time}.
dashboard.noResult: No results yet. Results are available after the scoring engine has run.
dashboard.notFinal: Results are available after the panel meeting confirms them.

cards.scl: Safety Culture Ladder equivalent track: indicative level {level}

charts.contextual: Contextual, not part of the organisation index
charts.adjusted: Characteristic values marked with an asterisk were adjusted by the panel meeting.

heatmap.strataTitle: Heat map of aspects by stratum
heatmap.unitsTitle: Heat map of aspects by unit
heatmap.intro: Survey score per aspect, the mean of survey answers on a 1 to 5 scale. The small number below the value is the respondent count.
heatmap.secondaryNote: Hidden so other cells cannot be back-calculated

divergence.title: Characteristics subject to the perception and evidence gap rule
divergence.intro: The gap between perception and evidence reached the threshold. When evidence is lower, the final value uses the evidence value.
divergence.none: No characteristic is subject to this rule.

gap.title: Perception gap between management and field workers
gap.intro: Mean survey score of the management group minus the field group, per aspect. Shown when both groups have at least 5 respondents.

comparison.title: Comparison across periods
comparison.intro: Previous assessments of the same organisation with the same instrument version.

quality.title: Data quality panel
quality.intro: Survey data quality statistics. Values from fewer than 5 respondents are hidden.
quality.alphaIntro: Threshold {min}. Computed from responses that answered every item in the dimension, after reversing negative items.
quality.rwgIntro: Threshold {min}. Below the threshold, aggregation to the organisation level is annotated and unit results should be read.
quality.responsesIntro: Flagged automatically and excluded from analysis only after assessor review. Unit and stratum are not shown so that responses are not easily recognised.
quality.uniform: Share of most common climate value
quality.closed: Responses can only be excluded or restored during data collection and scoring.
quality.rerun: Run the scoring engine again after excluding or restoring responses.

exportLabels.note: Cells with fewer than 5 respondents are hidden, together with cells that could be used to back-calculate them.
exportLabels.draft: Draft, not yet confirmed by the panel meeting
exportLabels.secondary: Hidden so other cells cannot be back-calculated
